 Order

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the order dated 22.11.2023 passed in M.A.C.C. No.94/2023 by the learned Member, MACT, District Ratlam (MP), whereby the claim of respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. In a nutshell, the facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 was filed on 21.03.2023 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 12.08.2022 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication in SLP (C) No.9152/2023.
Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17566 2 MP-1819-2024 in MACC No.94/2023.
4. I have heard counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
